events.text: Cairns was laid down by Walkers Limited at Maryborough, Queensland.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Cairns was laid down by Walkers Limited at Maryborough , Queensland on 31 March 1941 .

events.text: Cairns was launched by Mrs. R. D. Walker.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She was launched on 7 October 1941 by Mrs . R . D . Walker

events.text: Cairns was commissioned into the RAN.
events.subject: self
events.quote: commissioned into the RAN on 11 May 1942 .

events.text: Cairns was based in Fremantle and operated as a convoy escort, anti-submarine patroller, and minesweeper.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From entering service until 16 October 1942 , Cairns was based in Fremantle

events.text: The corvette was reassigned to the British Eastern Fleet and ordered to Kilindini, Kenya.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 16 October , the corvette was reassigned to the British Eastern Fleet

events.text: Cairns arrived at Kilindini, Kenya.
events.subject: self
events.quote: ordered to Kilindini , Kenya , arriving on 14 November

events.text: Cairns remained with the Eastern Fleet until January 1945.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Cairns remained with the Eastern Fleet until January 1945

events.text: The corvette was reassigned to the Mediterranean from June until September 1943.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The corvette was reassigned to the Mediterranean from June until September 1943

events.text: The corvette's reassignment to the Mediterranean ended in September 1943.
events.subject: self
events.quote: from June until September 1943

events.text: Cairns was involved in the Allied invasion of Sicily.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During this time , Cairns was involved in the Allied invasion of Sicily

events.text: A convoy Cairns was assigned to was attacked by Japanese submarine RO-110.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 11 February 1944 , a convoy Cairns was assigned to was attacked by Japanese submarine RO-110

events.text: The corvette was involved in the successful destruction of the submarine.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The corvette was involved in the successful destruction of the submarine

events.text: Cairns underwent a refit in Adelaide from May to July 1944.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Following a refit in Adelaide from May to July 1944

events.text: Cairns's refit in Adelaide ended in July 1944.
events.subject: self
events.quote: from May to July 1944

events.text: Cairns was redeployed to Colombo.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Cairns was redeployed to Colombo

events.text: Colombo was her base of operations until January 1945.
events.subject: self
events.quote: which was her base of operations until January 1945

events.text: The corvette was sent back to Australia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: when the corvette was sent back to Australia

events.text: On arrival in Australian waters, Cairns was assigned to the British Pacific Fleet.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Cairns was assigned to the British Pacific Fleet

events.text: The ship received the battle honour Pacific 1942–45.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Pacific 1942–45

events.text: The ship received the battle honour Indian Ocean 1942–45.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Indian Ocean 1942–45

events.text: The ship received the battle honour Sicily 1943.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Sicily 1943

events.text: The ship received the battle honour Okinawa 1945.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Okinawa 1945

events.text: Cairns was paid off in Brisbane.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Cairns was paid off in Brisbane on 17 January 1946 .

events.text: She was recommissioned into the Royal Australian Navy (RNLN) and renamed HNLMS Ambon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She was immediately recommissioned into the Royal Australian Navy ( RNLN ) and renamed HNLMS Ambon .

events.text: The ship was transferred to the Indonesian Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the ship was transferred to the Indonesian Navy on 6 April 1950

events.text: The ship was renamed KRI Banteng.
events.subject: self
events.quote: renamed KRI Banteng
